thesis: Everyday aesthetics concerns lived multisensory situations, access, maintenance and who can remain to enjoy improvements.

ideas.statement: Functional fit depends on real bodies and shared space; beauty can support common dignity while its benefits are privately captured.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The neighborhood scenarios illustrate access mechanisms, not proof that all improvements displace residents; comfort alone is not beauty.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The neighborhood scenarios illustrate access mechanisms, not proof that all improvements displace residents; comfort alone is not beauty.

audit.notes: Direct active-LLM all-unit analysis; distinct values and qualifications preserved.
